attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a corrected production character reference sheet, opaque PNG landscape 3:2 1536x1024. This is KOSTYA at 17, not his younger brother Sasha. Reference image 1 is the original approved Kostya17 sheet: preserve his outfit and identity, but enlarge the tiny figures to 85-90% of canvas height. Reference image 2 is Kostya38: preserve continuity with his warmer, more horizontal eyes, eyebrows and substantial straight nose, younger here, WITH HAIR and NO beard. Reference image 3 contains Sasha portraits and is an EXCLUSION / comparison reference only: do not copy Sasha's pointed cowlick, spiky triangular bangs, large round worried eyes or tiny pointed chin.
Layout exactly three full-length views of ONE SAME Kostya17 (front, left-facing profile, back) across the left two thirds, and one LARGE head and shoulders portrait on the right. All full figures same height and scale. Calm neutral standing pose, relaxed arms and visible hands. Lean lanky 17-year-old older brother. Tousled dark-brown WAVY HAIR, rounded loose waves, forehead partially open, lower flatter silhouette than Sasha's spikes; keep this same haircut in every view. Easy asymmetric half smile, relaxed slightly hooded brown eyes, straight substantial nose, longer oval face and gently defined chin. Close to the original Kostya, not a different invented person. Warm gray pullover hoodie with rolled sleeves to forearms, faded teal straight jeans, cream white socks, no shoes. NO mustard clothing, no jacket, no plaid and no baldness here.
Style must match these exact paper collage references: matte layered colored paper, clearly visible natural fibers, irregular cut edges, overlapping pieces with soft short contact shadows, restrained face details. Warm cream plain paper backdrop. Palette only warm gray, faded teal, cream, shaded brick brown and muted olive; no red. Crisp faces and edges, no depth of field, no painterly blurring, no film grain overlay. No labels, letters, numbers, diagrams, props, signature or watermark. Keep every head, hand and foot completely inside canvas.
attempts.review: Rejected: oversized pointed crown/cowlick still resembled Sasha.

reason: User rejected the mild wave-hair differentiation and requested clearly distinct facial structure, short curls and different clothing. Use distinct-v3.
